tools.name: agy_ask
tools.description: Send a one-shot prompt to the Google Antigravity CLI (agy) and return its response. Use to delegate a focused coding, debugging, or reasoning task to Gemini via Antigravity.

prompt.description: The prompt to send to agy

add_dir.description: Explicit directories to add to agy's workspace. Overrides the workspace default below.

workspace.description: auto (default): if no add_dir given, add the server's cwd so agy sees the repo — needed for coding tasks. none: no workspace (use for research / Q&A that needs no repo context).

timeout.description: Hard timeout in seconds (override when a task legitimately needs longer).

skip_permissions.description: Let agy edit files / run commands without approval prompts (headless agy otherwise declines them silently). Only honoured if the server was started with AGY_BRIDGE_ALLOW_SKIP_PERMISSIONS=1.

tools.name: agy_research
tools.description: Ask Antigravity to research a topic deeply.
